GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. “Guten Tag” means: (1 mark)
   A. Please
   B. Thank you
   C. Good night
   D. Good day / hello

2. When practising Intensive Reading Skimming, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Intensive Reading Skimming.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Intensive Reading Skimming.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Intensive Reading Skimming.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Intensive Reading Skimming.

3. When practising Reading for comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading for comprehension.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading for comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for comprehension.

   D. Copy random text without understanding Fluency Critical listening Tourist destinations and attractions.

5. When practising Reading comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading comprehension.

   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information ● biased listening ● listening for comprehension ● con.

7. When practising Listening comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening comprehension.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening comprehension.

8. When practising Intensive reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Intensive reading.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Intensive reading.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Intensive reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Intensive reading.

9. German for “school” is: (1 mark)
   A. Schule
   B. Wasser
   C. Buch
   D. Haus

10. When practising Extensive reading Scanning, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for details Conversational skills.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Descriptors Adjectives , Comparative, Superlative -Vorlieben Ordinal numbers Dem and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Listening for gist and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
